name: manual_179b0b
claim: A Phase 1 skill census is one row per card: summon, keep, or shrink. A blanket KEEP of every orama skill and SUMMON 0 is not a census. The archive directory is not a card; its nested council card has front matter and is a superseded redirect. The antigravity card is a live agy fan-out contract with Boundaries and has no upstream counterpart, so it stays. The other cards were not reviewed.

decisions.notes: Row 6840 claimed KEEP everything and said archive had no front matter. Both claims failed a direct read.
